nice_guideline_used: NICE NG136 (Hypertension in adults) and NICE NG203 (Chronic kidney disease)

medications.duration: Lifelong — review annually; titrate after 2 weeks to target BP <140/90 mmHg
medications.nice_justification: NG136 first‑line ACE inhibitor for patients <55 years, non‑Afro‑Caribbean; also NG203 ACE‑I recommended for CKD with hypertension

medications.dose: 40 mg once daily in the evening
medications.duration: Lifelong — review lipid panel in 12 weeks, then annually
medications.purpose: Reduce LDL‑C and cardiovascular risk in probable heterozygous FH / CKD
medications.nice_justification: NG203 recommends statin for all CKD patients and high LDL‑C; NG136 supports statin for primary prevention when 10‑year QRISK >10% (assumed high)

medications.duration: Until iron stores repleted — review Hb and ferritin in 4 weeks, then as needed
medications.nice_justification: NICE guideline for iron‑deficiency anemia recommends oral iron replacement

interactions_checked.interaction: No clinically significant pharmacokinetic interaction; estrogen may blunt antihypertensive effect
interactions_checked.action: Monitor blood pressure closely; consider switching to non‑estrogenic contraception if BP remains uncontrolled

interactions_checked.interaction: Minor increase in statin exposure reported with oral contraceptives, not clinically important at standard dose
interactions_checked.action: No dose adjustment needed; monitor liver enzymes as per statin safety monitoring

contraindications.reason: NICE NG136 and NG203 state no added benefit and increased risk of hyperkalaemia and renal impairment
contraindications.alternative: Use ACE‑I alone (Ramipril) or switch to ARB only if ACE‑I intolerant

contraindications.reason: Contraindicated in CKD (NG203) and may worsen hypertension
contraindications.alternative: Paracetamol for analgesia; avoid regular NSAIDs

contraindications.reason: eGFR unknown; NICE NG203 advises dose reduction or avoidance if eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m²
contraindications.alternative: Defer initiation until eGFR measured; consider low‑dose if eGFR ≥30

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m² for ACE‑I initiation; will verify with labs
Pregnancy status not documented – ACE‑I and statin are contraindicated in pregnancy; confirm patient is not pregnant before starting
Age and ethnicity not specified – ACE‑I chosen assuming age <55 and non‑Afro‑Caribbean; if age ≥55 or Afro‑Caribbean, consider amlodipine 5 mg as first‑line
QRISK score not calculated – assumed high cardiovascular risk given LDL‑C >200 mg/dL and probable FH
Allergy history not provided – ensure no known hypersensitivity to ACE‑I or statins before prescribing
treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg daily to achieve BP <140/90 mmHg, titrating as needed; initiate atorvastatin 40 mg nightly for LDL‑C reduction and cardiovascular protection; continue ferrous sulfate for anemia. Monitor renal function, electrolytes, liver enzymes, and blood pressure at specified intervals. Review contraception choice if hypertension remains uncontrolled. Avoid NSAIDs and defer metformin until eGFR is known.
